messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: Private deploy failure detected for customer 'Vocalis Health' (vpc-aurora-3). TLS cert rotation failed on ingress controller; client requests returning 503/502. Trigger: 5xx spike + synthetic checks failing. Paging oncall.
Oncall Maya: I'm oncall, grabbing the pager. ETA to join 2m. Any immediate mitigation documented?
Samir (SE): Seeing TLS handshake errors in the logs. Relevant error: `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority` for backend-proxy. Might be cert chain mismatch after rotation.
Helen (Account): Heads up to customer success: Vocalis primary contacts are listed in our account doc. They expect an initial acknowledgement within 10m. I'll draft the quick notify once we have impact.
DevOps - Raj: Jumping in — checking certs on vpc-aurora-3 ingress nodes now. If rotation failed we can fallback to previous cert bundle. Please hold traffic if we need certificate replacement.
Oncall Maya: Can you post the minimal status page blurb we should publish? Need short, non-technical customer-facing text.
StatusPage Bot: Suggested draft:
```
Investigating: Some customers on the Private (VPC) deployment may experience failed connections due to a TLS certificate rotation issue. We are actively investigating and working on a rollback. We'll update in 15 minutes.
```
Samir (SE): Root cause looks like the rotation job wrote an incomplete chain — `chain.pem` missing intermediate. Rolling back to last known good cert should restore connections. I'll prepare the rollback script.
Vocalis Pager: Vocalis Ops: Confirmed impact: their health checks show 503 to inference endpoints since 14:02 UTC. They're seeing failures in production. Please escalate.
Helen (Account): Acknowledged. I'll send an interim message to Vocalis CTO + infra lead: short, apologetic, timeline promise. Draft: "We're aware of connection failures to your private deployment; engineering is actively rolling back the certificate rotation and we expect service restoration within 10-20 minutes. We'll keep you updated every 10 minutes."
DevOps - Raj: Rolling back now on node 1/3. Command: `kubectl -n ingress set secret tls ingress-tls --cert=good.crt --key=good.key` (will mirror to node 2/3). Pushing in 30s.
Oncall Maya: Noted. Please post progress here when node(s) restored. Also capturing logs: `/var/log/nginx/error.log` shows handshake errors from 13:59-14:04.
Samir (SE): Node1 restored, ingress returned 200 for synthetic check. Now doing node2.
DevOps - Raj: Node2 restored. Node3 in progress.
Samir (SE): Node3 restored. All ingress nodes showing healthy; synthetic checks green across regions. Turning traffic back up.
StatusPage Bot: Update published: "Update: We've rolled back a TLS certificate rotation for affected private deployments. Synthetic checks are passing and we are monitoring. If you continue to see issues, contact support for your account."
Helen (Account): Sent targeted note to Vocalis: "Services restored after rollback; our engineers will run a post-mortem and share RCA within 24 hours. Please reply if you see anything unusual."
Vocalis Pager: Vocalis Ops: Confirmed restored on their side, all dependent services healthy. Thank you.
Ops Lead - Tessa: Good work. Next steps: 1) Samir/Raj to collect rotation job logs and cert artifacts. 2) Maya to prepare oncall timeline and actions. 3) Helen to coordinate customer comms follow-up. We'll schedule a 30m post-incident review and an action to harden rotation job (validation of full chain and dry-run). I'll take ownership of the RCA. :thumbsup:
Oncall Maya: Logged incident in postmortems channel and created status page incident link. Closing pager once we have RCA ticket created.
Samir (SE): Filing RCA ticket now: INF-4923. Attaching cert rotation logs and diff of rotation job. ETA for draft RCA: 24h.
Ops Lead - Tessa: Acknowledged. If any customer escalates beyond Vocalis, notify me directly. Closing thread after RCA link posted.
